candidate_rule: two non-promoted candidates per record: verified source fact or deterministic rounded-snapshot change, plus explicit scope guard

scope_guards.monthly_snapshot: BDUK contract values are rounded management-information snapshots limited to initial contract scope, with variable ingestion lag; they do not establish exact-address completion, availability, orderability or milestone compliance.
scope_guards.monthly_change: Arithmetic changes between rounded BDUK snapshots may reflect resubmissions, scope revisions or ingestion timing and must not be treated as parcel-level delivery or contractual milestone evidence.
scope_guards.continuity: Row continuity only describes comparable labels, suppliers and rounded counts across the selected snapshots; it does not establish service continuity or address-level availability.
scope_guards.consumer_process: Ofcom landline, provider-closure and customer-support guidance describes processes and protections; it does not establish current network availability or orderability at an exact address.
scope_guards.security_guidance: Ofcom anti-scam guidance is preventive consumer guidance and does not identify a specific caller, message, provider or address as fraudulent.
